findings.title: After cutover, an EQL-only release publishes npm and crate but silently skips the SQL release, docs and image
findings.label: match
findings.note: Identifies that eql-sql/docs/image if: lack a status function so the implicit success() skips them when publish-ffi upstream is skipped.

findings.title: Once armed, any branch with a `chore(release):` HEAD can publish an EQL prerelease to npm and crates.io without review
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same dispatch-from-unmerged-branch exposure: prerelease jobs hold id-token/contents write with no environment gate, as the cited lines and commit message show.

findings.title: classify becomes a new prerequisite of every JS and FFI publish
findings.label: valid
findings.note: classify is a new job and ffi-artifacts/publish-ffi/release now require its mode=='production' output, so a classify failure blocks JS/FFI releases; low-impact but real and introduced by this change (push trigger itself was pre-existing).

findings.title: Docs site no longer receives a rebuild webhook on @cipherstash/stack releases
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: rebuild-docs.yml is deleted but AGENTS.md states the site and webhook are retired; impact is speculative and immaterial to release risk.
